solves.reasoning: (A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: abandoned — impoverished — persuaded
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: hated — outstanding — helpful
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: opportunity — grounding — frequent
마커 원문대조: ③ loved ≠ 원문 hated
마커 원문대조: ① ordinary ≠ 원문 outstanding
마커 원문대조: ④ detrimental ≠ 원문 helpful
빈칸 원문대조: abandoned (his father ___ the family)
빈칸 원문대조: persuaded (he ___ his mother to allow)
빈칸 원문대조: opportunity (given the ___ to work)
impoverished = 빈곤한. wealthy(부유)/prosperous(번영)/privileged(특권)는 반의어. destitute(빈곤한)가 동의어
outstanding = 뛰어난. ordinary(평범)/moderate(보통)/adequate(충분)는 반의어/무관. exceptional(탁월한)이 동의어
frequent = 잦은. scarce(드문)/unusual(특이)/random(무작위)는 반의어/무관. regular(규칙적인)가 동의어
famous 반의어. renowned(유명)/celebrated(유명)/notable(주목할만)는 동의어. obscure(무명의)가 반의어
helpful 반의어. beneficial(유익)/supportive(지지)/favorable(유리)는 동의어. detrimental(해로운)이 반의어
(A) to gain employment: gain=얻다(동사). (B) a significant gain: gain=이익(명사). 얻다—이익 = ③
a period of training to learn skills for a job = apprenticeship(도제/견습). employment(고용)/career(경력)/grounding(기초)는 부적합
an + _____ for him: 관사 an 뒤 명사 → apprentice → apprenticeship
from + _____: 전치사 뒤 동명사 → observe → observing
빈칸 원문대조: an outstanding grounding (gave him ___ for the future)
빈칸 원문대조: within walking distance (National Gallery, ___ of Swan & Edgar)
